scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.verify:launch-preflight: npm run verify:secret-templates && npm run verify:cloudflare-only && npm run verify:source-assets && npm run verify:live-zone && npm run verify:cloudflare-redirects && npm run verify:preview-indexing && npm run verify:security-headers && npm run verify:migration && npm run verify:live-crawl
scripts.preview: NEXT_PUBLIC_PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENT=true NEXT_PUBLIC_ASSET_URL=https://staging.littlegiantsnursery.org opennextjs-cloudflare build --env preview && npm run verify:build-indexing:preview && opennextjs-cloudflare preview --env preview
scripts.deploy:preview: NEXT_PUBLIC_PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENT=true NEXT_PUBLIC_ASSET_URL=https://staging.littlegiantsnursery.org opennextjs-cloudflare build --env preview && npm run verify:build-indexing:preview && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env preview
scripts.deploy: NEXT_PUBLIC_PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENT=false NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://www.littlegiantsnursery.org NEXT_PUBLIC_ASSET_URL=https://www.littlegiantsnursery.org opennextjs-cloudflare build --env="" && npm run verify:build-indexing:production && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env="" && npm run sync:cloudflare-redirects
scripts.upload: NEXT_PUBLIC_PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENT=false NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://www.littlegiantsnursery.org NEXT_PUBLIC_ASSET_URL=https://www.littlegiantsnursery.org opennextjs-cloudflare build --env="" && npm run verify:build-indexing:production && opennextjs-cloudflare upload --env=""
